lines.beaver_en: Hello. What is today's lecture topic?
lines.en: Today I will talk about changes in technology and the press.

lines.beaver_en: First, how has science and technology changed?
lines.en: Thanks to satellites, wireless networks have expanded.

lines.learner: 네, 이제 선 없는 무선 이어폰을 많이 씁니다.
lines.en: Yes, now many people use cordless wireless earphones.
lines.roman: Ne, ije seon eomneun museon ieoponeul mani sseumnida.

lines.learner: 일간지 지면은 줄었는가 하면 댓글 난은 커졌습니다.
lines.en: While daily papers' page space has shrunk, comment sections have grown.
lines.roman: Ilganji jimyeoneun jureonneunga hamyeon daetgeul naneun keojyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: How do readers read the news?
lines.learner: 종이 구독은 줄고 기사 조회 수는 늘었습니다.
lines.en: Paper subscriptions fell, and article views rose.
lines.roman: Jongi gudogeun julgo gisa johoe suneun neureotseumnida.

lines.en: Listeners log in with their IDs and leave comments.

lines.beaver_en: Has the broadcasting scene changed too?
lines.learner: 리포터는 무인 카메라를 쓰고, 방청객도 직접 찍습니다.
lines.en: Reporters use unmanned cameras, and audience members film too.
lines.roman: Ripoteoneun muin kamerareul sseugo, bangcheonggaekdo jikjeop jjikseumnida.

lines.learner: 무선 기술은 편리한가 하면 해킹 위험도 큽니다.
lines.en: While wireless tech is convenient, the hacking risk is also high.
lines.roman: Museon gisureun pyeollihanga hamyeon haeking wiheomdo keumnida.

lines.beaver: 과학기술과 미디어에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell us more about science, tech, and media?
lines.beaver_roman: Gwahakgisulgwa midieoe daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 물리와 화학이 발전해서 고체 배터리도 나왔습니다.
lines.en: As physics and chemistry advanced, solid-state batteries appeared.
lines.roman: Mulliwa hwahagi baljeonhaeseo goche baeteorido nawatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. It was a really interesting lecture.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 질문은 댓글 난에 남겨 주십시오.
lines.en: Thank you. Please leave questions in the comment section.
lines.roman: Gamsahamnida. Jilmuneun daetgeul nane namgyeo jusipsio.
